sermon.title: Power of God’s Person - September 17, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Jesus is the Word made flesh, God with us. God revealed Himself fully in the Son—hear Him. Power went out from Him to heal all who came, even Gentiles from Tyre and Sidon. Like the woman with the flow of blood and the centurion, seek Him humbly and touch Him.
